tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a verified sign-in, recurring Starter/Pro plan and explicit agent access approval link. Show only onboarding_url and user_code to the human; keep the token private. This does not itself charge or issue a key.

tools.name: get_onboarding_status
tools.description: Check approval and signed-webhook-backed entitlement, without identity or secrets. Poll every 5 seconds; complete only when ready. Stop on issued, denied or expired.

tools.name: complete_onboarding
tools.description: Deliver a dedicated revocable inference key exactly once after human approval and active entitlement. Never retry after issuance or ambiguous delivery; check status instead. Keep the key private and configure the client only with user approval.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback or report a Kourier error, attributed to your account. Requires your Kourier API key in the MCP connection's Authorization: Bearer header, never in tool arguments. Submit only what the user wants to share; exclude API keys, tokens, passwords, personal data, and private code or logs. In

tools.description: Kourier's plans, monthly prices, concurrency limits, and what has no usage cap.

tools.name: get_setup_instructions
tools.description: Configuration for using Kourier from Oh My Pi, Claude Code, Codex CLI, or any OpenAI-compatible client.

tools.name: get_api_key_instructions
tools.description: How a person or an agent obtains a Kourier API key: dashboard sign-up, agent sign-in (auth.md), or OAuth with PKCE.

tools.name: get_models
tools.description: The model Kourier serves, its API model string, and context limits.
